defEn: to get or gain something, especially knowledge or a skill
defUz: biror narsani, ayniqsa bilim yoki ko'nikmani egallash

examples.en: She acquired a good knowledge of French while living in Paris.
examples.uz: U Parijda yashar ekan, fransuz tilini yaxshi egalladi.

defEn: including everything; complete and wide-ranging
defUz: hamma narsani qamrab oluvchi; to'liq va keng qamrovli

examples.en: The report gives a comprehensive overview of the problem.
examples.uz: Hisobot muammoning keng qamrovli sharhini beradi.

defEn: the subjects studied in a school or course
defUz: maktab yoki kursda o'rganiladigan fanlar to'plami

examples.en: Maths is a core part of the school curriculum.
examples.uz: Matematika maktab o'quv dasturining asosiy qismidir.

defEn: an official record showing you have passed an exam or course
defUz: imtihon yoki kursni tamomlaganingizni tasdiqlovchi hujjat/malaka

examples.en: You need the right qualifications for this job.
examples.uz: Bu ish uchun tegishli malakalarga ega bo'lishingiz kerak.

defEn: a university student who has not yet taken a first degree
defUz: hali birinchi diplomini olmagan universitet talabasi

examples.en: She is an undergraduate studying biology.
examples.uz: U biologiya o'qiyotgan bakalavr talabasi.

defEn: the latest time by which something must be finished
defUz: biror ish tugatilishi kerak bo'lgan oxirgi muddat

examples.en: We have to meet the deadline by Friday.
examples.uz: Biz muddatga juma kunigacha ulgurishimiz kerak.

defEn: a very high mark or grade; a clear difference
defUz: juda yuqori baho; aniq farq

examples.en: He passed the exam with distinction.
examples.uz: U imtihonni a'lo baho bilan topshirdi.

defEn: eager and willing to work hard to achieve something
defUz: maqsadga erishish uchun tirishqoq va intiluvchan

examples.en: Motivated students usually achieve better results.
examples.uz: Intiluvchan talabalar odatda yaxshiroq natijaga erishadi.

defEn: teaching, or the money paid for it
defUz: dars berish yoki shu uchun to'lanadigan haq

examples.en: University tuition fees have risen sharply.
examples.uz: Universitet o'qish haqi keskin oshdi.

defEn: done carefully and completely
defUz: puxta va sinchkovlik bilan bajarilgan

examples.en: The police carried out a thorough investigation.
examples.uz: Politsiya puxta tergov o'tkazdi.

defEn: a person who formally asks for a job or place
defUz: ish yoki o'ringa rasmiy ariza beruvchi shaxs

examples.en: There were over a hundred applicants for the position.
examples.uz: Lavozimga yuzdan ortiq nomzod bor edi.

defEn: a person you work with
defUz: siz bilan birga ishlaydigan kishi, hamkasb

examples.en: I get on well with most of my colleagues.
examples.uz: Men ko'pchilik hamkasblarim bilan yaxshi til topishaman.

defEn: a move to a more important job
defUz: muhimroq lavozimga ko'tarilish

examples.en: She was offered a promotion after two years.
examples.uz: Unga ikki yildan so'ng lavozimda ko'tarilish taklif qilindi.

defEn: no longer needed at work and so dismissed
defUz: ishda keraksiz bo'lib qolgani uchun bo'shatilgan

examples.en: Hundreds of workers were made redundant when the factory closed.
examples.uz: Zavod yopilganda yuzlab ishchilar ishdan bo'shatildi.

defEn: a set period of working time
defUz: belgilangan ish vaqti, smena

examples.en: Nurses often work the night shift.
examples.uz: Hamshiralar ko'pincha tungi smenada ishlaydi.

defEn: money paid regularly for work, often weekly
defUz: mehnat uchun muntazam to'lanadigan haq (ko'pincha haftalik)

examples.en: The factory pays a decent hourly wage.
examples.uz: Zavod munosib soatbay ish haqi to'laydi.

defEn: all the people who work in a company or country
defUz: kompaniya yoki mamlakatdagi barcha ishchilar

examples.en: The company has a workforce of over five thousand.
examples.uz: Kompaniyada besh mingdan ortiq ishchi kuchi bor.

defEn: working for yourself, not for an employer
defUz: boshqa ish beruvchiga emas, o'ziga ishlaydigan

examples.en: Since last year he has been self-employed.
examples.uz: O'tgan yildan beri u o'z ishi bilan shug'ullanadi.

defEn: needing a lot of effort, time or skill
defUz: ko'p kuch, vaqt yoki mahorat talab qiladigan

examples.en: Teaching can be a very demanding job.
examples.uz: O'qituvchilik juda og'ir ish bo'lishi mumkin.

defEn: to travel regularly between home and work
defUz: uy va ish o'rtasida muntazam qatnash

examples.en: She commutes to the city centre every day.
examples.uz: U har kuni shahar markaziga qatnaydi.

defEn: a sign that you have an illness
defUz: kasallik borligini ko'rsatuvchi belgi/alomat

examples.en: A high temperature is a common symptom of flu.
examples.uz: Yuqori harorat grippning keng tarqalgan alomatidir.

defEn: the act of finding out what illness someone has
defUz: kasallikni aniqlash, tashxis qo'yish

examples.en: Early diagnosis can save lives.
examples.uz: Erta tashxis hayotni saqlab qolishi mumkin.

defEn: to become healthy again after an illness
defUz: kasallikdan keyin yana sog'ayish

examples.en: It took him a month to recover from the operation.
examples.uz: Operatsiyadan keyin tuzalishi unga bir oy vaqt oldi.

defEn: physical harm or damage to the body
defUz: tanaga yetgan jismoniy shikast, jarohat

examples.en: He suffered a serious knee injury while playing football.
examples.uz: U futbol o'ynayotganda tizzasidan jiddiy jarohat oldi.

defEn: a doctor's written order for medicine
defUz: shifokorning dori uchun yozma buyrug'i, retsept

examples.en: You can only get this medicine on prescription.
examples.uz: Bu dorini faqat retsept orqali olishingiz mumkin.

defEn: involving a lot of sitting and little exercise
defUz: ko'p o'tirish va kam harakatni o'z ichiga olgan

examples.en: A sedentary lifestyle can lead to health problems.
examples.uz: Harakatsiz turmush tarzi sog'liq muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin.

defEn: the process of getting the food needed for health
defUz: salomatlik uchun zarur oziq olish jarayoni, ovqatlanish

examples.en: Good nutrition is essential for children.
examples.uz: Yaxshi ovqatlanish bolalar uchun juda muhim.

defEn: (of a disease) able to spread from person to person
defUz: (kasallik haqida) odamdan odamga yuqadigan

examples.en: Measles is a highly contagious disease.
examples.uz: Qizamiq juda yuqumli kasallik.

defEn: protected against a disease
defUz: kasallikka qarshi himoyalangan, immunitetli

examples.en: Vaccines help the body become immune to disease.
examples.uz: Vaksinalar tanaga kasallikka qarshi immunitet hosil qilishga yordam beradi.

defEn: the state of being healthy and happy
defUz: sog'lom va baxtli bo'lish holati, farovonlik

examples.en: Regular exercise improves your mental well-being.
examples.uz: Muntazam mashq ruhiy salomatligingizni yaxshilaydi.

defEn: the place to which someone is going
defUz: kishi boradigan joy, manzil

examples.en: Spain is a popular tourist destination.
examples.uz: Ispaniya mashhur sayyohlik manzili.

defEn: a place to live or stay
defUz: yashash yoki turish joyi

examples.en: The price includes flights and accommodation.
examples.uz: Narxga parvozlar va turar joy kiradi.

defEn: a plan of a journey, listing places to visit
defUz: tashrif joylari ko'rsatilgan sayohat rejasi

examples.en: Our itinerary includes three cities in five days.
examples.uz: Bizning marshrutimiz besh kunda uchta shaharni o'z ichiga oladi.

defEn: made to happen later than planned
defUz: rejalashtirilgandan kechroqqa qoldirilgan

examples.en: Our flight was delayed by three hours.
examples.uz: Bizning parvozimiz uch soatga kechiktirildi.

defEn: the bags you take when travelling
defUz: sayohatda olib yuriladigan sumkalar, yuk

examples.en: You are allowed one piece of hand luggage.
examples.uz: Sizga bitta qo'l yukiga ruxsat beriladi.

defEn: the act of leaving, especially on a journey
defUz: jo'nash, ketish (ayniqsa safarda)

examples.en: Please be at the airport two hours before departure.
examples.uz: Iltimos, jo'nashdan ikki soat oldin aeroportda bo'ling.

defEn: extremely beautiful or impressive
defUz: nihoyatda chiroyli yoki hayratlanarli

examples.en: The view from the top was breathtaking.
examples.uz: Cho'qqidan ko'rinadigan manzara hayratlanarli edi.

defEn: far away from towns or people
defUz: shahar yoki odamlardan uzoq, olis

examples.en: They live in a remote village in the mountains.
examples.uz: Ular tog'lardagi olis bir qishloqda yashaydi.

defEn: a short trip, usually for pleasure
defUz: qisqa sayohat (odatda zavq uchun)

examples.en: We went on a day excursion to the old town.
examples.uz: Biz eski shaharga bir kunlik ekskursiyaga bordik.

defEn: an official mark allowing you to enter a country
defUz: mamlakatga kirishga ruxsat beruvchi rasmiy hujjat, viza

examples.en: You need a visa to enter the country.
examples.uz: Mamlakatga kirish uchun sizga viza kerak.

defEn: the making of air, water or land dirty and harmful
defUz: havo, suv yoki yerni iflos va zararli qilish

examples.en: Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.
examples.uz: Havo ifloslanishi katta shaharlarda jiddiy muammo.

defEn: able to continue without harming the environment
defUz: atrof-muhitga zarar bermay davom ettirish mumkin bo'lgan

examples.en: We must develop sustainable sources of energy.
examples.uz: Biz barqaror energiya manbalarini rivojlantirishimiz kerak.

defEn: (of a species) at risk of dying out
defUz: (tur haqida) yo'qolib ketish xavfidagi

examples.en: Pandas are an endangered species.
examples.uz: Pandalar yo'qolish xavfida bo'lgan tur.

defEn: a gas or substance sent out into the air
defUz: havoga chiqariladigan gaz yoki modda

examples.en: The government wants to cut carbon emissions.
examples.uz: Hukumat uglerod chiqindilarini kamaytirmoqchi.

defEn: (of energy) able to be replaced naturally
defUz: (energiya haqida) tabiiy ravishda qayta tiklanadigan

examples.en: Solar power is a renewable source of energy.
examples.uz: Quyosh energiyasi qayta tiklanadigan energiya manbai.

defEn: a long period with little or no rain
defUz: yomg'ir kam yoki umuman yog'maydigan uzoq davr, qurg'oqchilik

examples.en: The long drought destroyed most of the crops.
examples.uz: Uzoq davom etgan qurg'oqchilik hosilning ko'p qismini yo'q qildi.

defEn: the natural home of an animal or plant
defUz: hayvon yoki o'simlikning tabiiy yashash joyi

examples.en: Cutting down forests destroys the habitat of many animals.
examples.uz: O'rmonlarni kesish ko'plab hayvonlarning yashash muhitini yo'q qiladi.

defEn: the protection of nature and the environment
defUz: tabiat va atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish

examples.en: The charity works for the conservation of wildlife.
examples.uz: Bu xayriya tashkiloti yovvoyi tabiatni muhofaza qilish uchun ishlaydi.

defEn: to treat used things so they can be used again
defUz: ishlatilgan narsalarni qayta foydalanish uchun qayta ishlash

examples.en: We recycle paper, glass and plastic at home.
examples.uz: Biz uyda qog'oz, shisha va plastikni qayta ishlaymiz.

defEn: the gradual rise in the Earth's temperature
defUz: Yer haroratining asta-sekin ko'tarilishi

examples.en: Global warming is causing sea levels to rise.
examples.uz: Global isish dengiz sathining ko'tarilishiga sabab bo'lmoqda.

defEn: a piece of equipment made for a purpose
defUz: ma'lum maqsad uchun yaratilgan asbob, qurilma

examples.en: Modern phones are powerful devices.
examples.uz: Zamonaviy telefonlar kuchli qurilmalar.

defEn: a new idea, method or invention
defUz: yangi g'oya, usul yoki ixtiro

examples.en: The company is known for its technological innovation.
examples.uz: Kompaniya texnologik innovatsiyasi bilan tanilgan.

defEn: an important discovery or development
defUz: muhim kashfiyot yoki yutuq

examples.en: Scientists have made a major breakthrough in cancer research.
examples.uz: Olimlar saraton tadqiqotida katta yutuqqa erishdi.

defEn: made by people, not natural
defUz: tabiiy emas, inson tomonidan yaratilgan, sun'iy

examples.en: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work.
examples.uz: Sun'iy intellekt ishlash usulimizni o'zgartirmoqda.

defEn: a scientific test to learn something
defUz: biror narsani bilish uchun ilmiy sinov, tajriba

examples.en: They carried out an experiment to test the theory.
examples.uz: Ular nazariyani tekshirish uchun tajriba o'tkazdilar.

defEn: facts or information used for analysis
defUz: tahlil uchun ishlatiladigan faktlar yoki ma'lumotlar

examples.en: The app collects data about how people exercise.
examples.uz: Ilova odamlar qanday mashq qilishi haqida ma'lumot to'playdi.

defEn: careful study to discover new facts
defUz: yangi faktlarni topish uchun puxta o'rganish, tadqiqot

examples.en: Years of research led to the new vaccine.
examples.uz: Yillar davomidagi tadqiqot yangi vaksinaga olib keldi.

defEn: working by itself without human control
defUz: inson aralashuvisiz o'zi ishlaydigan, avtomatik

examples.en: The doors open with an automatic sensor.
examples.uz: Eshiklar avtomatik sensor yordamida ochiladi.

defEn: to make something better or more modern
defUz: biror narsani yaxshilash yoki zamonaviylashtirish

examples.en: I need to upgrade my computer's memory.
examples.uz: Men kompyuterimning xotirasini yangilashim kerak.

defEn: the most modern and advanced
defUz: eng zamonaviy va ilg'or

examples.en: The lab uses cutting-edge technology.
examples.uz: Laboratoriya eng zamonaviy texnologiyadan foydalanadi.

defEn: a person who sees an event and can describe it
defUz: voqeani ko'rgan va ta'riflay oladigan shaxs, guvoh

examples.en: A witness described the man to the police.
examples.uz: Guvoh erkakni politsiyaga ta'rifladi.

defEn: a person thought to have committed a crime
defUz: jinoyat sodir etgan deb gumon qilingan shaxs

examples.en: The police arrested two suspects last night.
examples.uz: Politsiya kecha ikki gumondorni hibsga oldi.

defEn: facts or signs that prove something
defUz: biror narsani isbotlovchi faktlar yoki belgilar, dalil

examples.en: There was not enough evidence to convict him.
examples.uz: Uni ayblash uchun yetarli dalil yo'q edi.

defEn: the legal process of deciding if someone is guilty
defUz: kishi aybdor yoki yo'qligini hal qiluvchi sud jarayoni

examples.en: The trial lasted three weeks.
examples.uz: Sud jarayoni uch hafta davom etdi.

defEn: having done something wrong or illegal
defUz: noto'g'ri yoki noqonuniy ish qilgan, aybdor

examples.en: The jury found him guilty of theft.
examples.uz: Hakamlar hay'ati uni o'g'rilikda aybdor deb topdi.

defEn: the punishment given by a court
defUz: sud tomonidan beriladigan jazo, hukm

examples.en: He received a five-year prison sentence.
examples.uz: U besh yillik qamoq jazosini oldi.

defEn: an illegal act; a crime
defUz: noqonuniy harakat; jinoyat, huquqbuzarlik

examples.en: Drink-driving is a serious offence.
examples.uz: Mast holda haydash jiddiy huquqbuzarlik.

defEn: to officially decide that someone is guilty
defUz: kishini rasmiy ravishda aybdor deb topish

examples.en: He was convicted of fraud.
examples.uz: U firibgarlikda aybdor deb topildi.

defEn: a person harmed by a crime or accident
defUz: jinoyat yoki baxtsiz hodisadan zarar ko'rgan shaxs, jabrlanuvchi

examples.en: The victim was taken to hospital.
examples.uz: Jabrlanuvchi kasalxonaga olib ketildi.

defEn: money paid as a punishment
defUz: jazo sifatida to'lanadigan pul, jarima

examples.en: She had to pay a heavy fine for speeding.
examples.uz: U tezlikni oshirgani uchun katta jarima to'lashga majbur bo'ldi.

defEn: to send out a programme on TV or radio
defUz: TV yoki radioda dasturni efirga uzatish

examples.en: The match was broadcast live around the world.
examples.uz: O'yin butun dunyoga jonli efirda uzatildi.

defEn: the reporting of news by the media
defUz: ommaviy axborot vositalarida yangiliklarni yoritish

examples.en: There was wide media coverage of the event.
examples.uz: Tadbir ommaviy axborot vositalarida keng yoritildi.

defEn: the title of a news story
defUz: yangilik sarlavhasi

examples.en: The story made the headlines in every newspaper.
examples.uz: Bu voqea har bir gazetaning bosh sarlavhasiga chiqdi.

defEn: a person who writes news for the media
defUz: ommaviy axborot uchun yangilik yozadigan kishi, jurnalist

examples.en: The journalist interviewed several witnesses.
examples.uz: Jurnalist bir necha guvoh bilan suhbatlashdi.

defEn: a notice that promotes a product or service
defUz: mahsulot yoki xizmatni targ'ib qiluvchi e'lon, reklama

examples.en: I saw an advertisement for the job online.
examples.uz: Men ish haqidagi reklamani internetda ko'rdim.

defEn: the people who watch, listen to or read something
defUz: biror narsani tomosha qiluvchi yoki o'qiydigan odamlar, auditoriya

examples.en: The show attracts a huge television audience.
examples.uz: Ko'rsatuv juda katta televizion auditoriyani jalb qiladi.

defEn: able to be trusted or depended on
defUz: ishonsa va tayansa bo'ladigan, ishonchli

examples.en: Always check that the source of news is reliable.
examples.uz: Har doim yangilik manbasi ishonchli ekanini tekshiring.

examples.en: He is a reliable friend who never lets you down.
examples.uz: U sizni hech qachon yolg'iz qoldirmaydigan ishonchli do'st.

defEn: unfairly preferring one side
defUz: bir tomonni nohaq yoqlovchi, bir tomonlama

examples.en: The report was clearly biased against the government.
examples.uz: Hisobot aniq hukumatga qarshi bir tomonlama edi.

defEn: to pay to regularly receive something
defUz: biror narsani muntazam olish uchun obuna bo'lish

examples.en: Thousands of people subscribe to her channel.
examples.uz: Minglab odamlar uning kanaliga obuna bo'lgan.

defEn: the control or banning of information
defUz: ma'lumotni nazorat qilish yoki taqiqlash, senzura

examples.en: There is strict censorship of the press in some countries.
examples.uz: Ba'zi mamlakatlarda matbuotga nisbatan qattiq senzura mavjud.

defEn: to have enough money to buy something
defUz: biror narsani sotib olishga puli yetishi

examples.en: We cannot afford a new car this year.
examples.uz: Bu yil bizning yangi mashinaga qurbimiz yetmaydi.

defEn: something bought for less than its real value
defUz: haqiqiy qiymatidan arzon olingan narsa

examples.en: At half price, the coat was a real bargain.
examples.uz: Yarim narxda palto haqiqatan ham arzon xarid edi.

defEn: money paid back to a customer
defUz: mijozga qaytarilgan pul

examples.en: If it does not work, you can ask for a refund.
examples.uz: Agar ishlamasa, pulni qaytarishni so'rashingiz mumkin.

defEn: an amount taken off the usual price
defUz: odatdagi narxdan chegirilgan miqdor, chegirma

examples.en: Students get a ten per cent discount.
examples.uz: Talabalar o'n foiz chegirma oladi.

defEn: a paper showing you have paid
defUz: to'lov qilganingizni ko'rsatuvchi qog'oz, chek

examples.en: Keep the receipt in case you want to return it.
examples.uz: Qaytarmoqchi bo'lsangiz, chekni saqlab qo'ying.

defEn: a person who buys goods or services
defUz: tovar yoki xizmat sotib oluvchi, iste'molchi

examples.en: Consumers want better quality at lower prices.
examples.uz: Iste'molchilar arzonroq narxda yaxshiroq sifat istaydi.

defEn: a plan of how to spend money
defUz: pulni qanday sarflash rejasi, byudjet

examples.en: We are decorating the house on a tight budget.
examples.uz: Biz uyni cheklangan byudjet bilan bezatyapmiz.

defEn: to put money into something to make a profit
defUz: foyda olish uchun pul kiritish, sarmoya qilish

examples.en: They invested a lot of money in the business.
examples.uz: Ular biznesga ko'p pul sarmoya kiritdi.

defEn: money that you owe to someone
defUz: kimgadir qarz bo'lgan pul

examples.en: He is trying to pay off his debts.
examples.uz: U qarzlarini to'lashga harakat qilyapti.

defEn: worth a lot of money or very useful
defUz: katta pulga arziydigan yoki juda foydali, qimmatbaho

examples.en: The painting is extremely valuable.
examples.uz: Bu rasm nihoyatda qimmatbaho.

defEn: feeling thankful for something
defUz: biror narsa uchun minnatdorlik his qiladigan

examples.en: I am really grateful for all your help.
examples.uz: Barcha yordamingiz uchun chindan ham minnatdorman.

defEn: worried and nervous
defUz: tashvishli va asabiy, xavotirli

examples.en: She felt anxious before the interview.
examples.uz: U suhbatdan oldin xavotirda edi.

defEn: very pleased and happy
defUz: juda mamnun va xursand

examples.en: We were delighted to hear your good news.
examples.uz: Yaxshi xabaringizni eshitib juda xursand bo'ldik.

defEn: sad because something was not as good as hoped
defUz: kutilgandek bo'lmagani uchun xafa, hafsalasi pir bo'lgan

examples.en: He was disappointed with his exam results.
examples.uz: U imtihon natijalaridan hafsalasi pir bo'ldi.

defEn: feeling ashamed or awkward
defUz: uyalgan yoki noqulay his qiladigan, xijolat tortgan

examples.en: I felt embarrassed when I forgot her name.
examples.uz: Uning ismini unutganimda xijolat tortdim.

defEn: extremely angry
defUz: nihoyatda g'azablangan

examples.en: My parents were furious when I came home late.
examples.uz: Uyga kech kelganimda ota-onam juda g'azablandi.

defEn: glad that something bad did not happen
defUz: yomon narsa bo'lmagani uchun yengil tortgan

examples.en: I was relieved to hear that everyone was safe.
examples.uz: Hamma omon ekanini eshitib yengil tortdim.

defEn: the feeling of sharing another's sadness
defUz: boshqaning qayg'usini his qilish, hamdardlik

examples.en: She showed great sympathy for the victims.
examples.uz: U jabrlanuvchilarga katta hamdardlik bildirdi.

defEn: strongly affected by a feeling or amount
defUz: his yoki miqdor ta'sirida bosib qolgan, to'lib ketgan

examples.en: She was overwhelmed by all the support she received.
examples.uz: U olgan barcha qo'llab-quvvatlovdan his-tuyg'ularga to'lib ketdi.

defEn: to make someone feel calm and less worried
defUz: kishini tinchlantirish, xavotirini kamaytirish

examples.en: The doctor reassured me that it was nothing serious.
examples.uz: Shifokor meni jiddiy narsa emasligiga ishontirib tinchlantirdi.

defEn: a person you know but who is not a close friend
defUz: tanish, lekin yaqin do'st bo'lmagan kishi

examples.en: He is just an acquaintance, not a close friend.
examples.uz: U shunchaki tanish, yaqin do'st emas.

defEn: to disagree, often angrily
defUz: kelishmaslik, ko'pincha jahl bilan bahslashish/janjallashish

examples.en: They often argue about money.
examples.uz: Ular tez-tez pul ustida janjallashishadi.

defEn: always faithful and supportive
defUz: har doim sodiq va qo'llab-quvvatlovchi, vafodor

examples.en: A dog is a loyal companion.
examples.uz: It sodiq hamrohdir.

defEn: to have a friendly relationship
defUz: yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish, til topishish

examples.en: Do you get on well with your neighbours?
examples.uz: Qo'shnilaringiz bilan yaxshi chiqishasizmi?

defEn: to stop being friendly after an argument
defUz: janjaldan keyin do'stlikni to'xtatish, urishib qolish

examples.en: The two brothers fell out over the inheritance.
examples.uz: Ikki aka-uka meros ustida urishib qolishdi.

defEn: giving help and encouragement
defUz: yordam va dalda beruvchi, qo'llab-quvvatlovchi

examples.en: My family has always been very supportive.
examples.uz: Oilam har doim juda qo'llab-quvvatlovchi bo'lgan.

defEn: to believe someone is honest and reliable
defUz: kimningdir halol va ishonchli ekaniga ishonish

examples.en: I trust her completely.
examples.uz: Men unga to'liq ishonaman.

defEn: careful about others' feelings
defUz: o'zgalar hissiyotiga e'tiborli

examples.en: It was very considerate of you to call.
examples.uz: Qo'ng'iroq qilganingiz juda e'tiborli ish bo'ldi.

defEn: a meeting of people after a long time apart
defUz: uzoq ayriliqdan keyingi qayta uchrashuv

examples.en: We have a family reunion every summer.
examples.uz: Bizda har yozda oilaviy qayta uchrashuv bo'ladi.
